name: spedf_burst_18
notes: NEW Tier-2 case (Test_Design_IOExt.md ~line 411: small_burst anti-starvation). 16 small reads + 2 large reads in ONE 18-request batch (batch_size 18 so trace_driver submits everything in one io_uring_enter; the standard rig's batch 8 cannot produce the interleave because the driver barriers on batch completion — trace_driver.c:282-367). All within-lane submission orders == sector ASC (robust to arrival ties); all extents non-adjacent. Burst semantics (bpf.c:14,118,165,215-216): first insert re-arms burst to 8; 8 small dispatches exhaust it; the 9th dispatch has burst==0 -> large_should_run TRUE -> L204800 and burst reset to 8; next 8 smalls; then both small lanes empty -> L208896. Expected ISSUE interleave: S x8, L204800, S x8, L208896. Verifies small_burst_left anti-starvation directly.
